head: Tripmo AI group trip planner lets each friend plan through ChatGPT or Claude
dek: Tripmo is a new shared trip plan that each person in a group fills in by talking to their own AI, such as ChatGPT, Claude or Grok. Places, flights and bookings land in one plan on a map, sorted by day.
details: Tripmo has no AI of its own: you connect it once through a connector in your AI's settings. The group rates the places being considered, and the plan tracks bookings, costs and receipts; tickets and files are kept for offline use. A Trip Pass costs $7.49 for one trip with up to 5 people, and Frequent Flyer costs $34.90 a year; friends join free, and both have a 14-day refund for anything unused. It runs as a web app.
where: Web app, works with ChatGPT, Claude and Grok; $7.49 per trip or $34.90 a year
means: If group trips end in a messy chat thread, this puts everyone's finds in one plan without making them learn a new app.
todo: Only the trip owner pays, so one person can try it with a single Trip Pass before the group commits.
thumb_words: PLAN GROUP TRIPS WITH YOUR OWN AI
